rows.en: Zigrim Soldier A: "Captain! We've detected Prana signatures!
Touya: "Don't worry. Kasumi will be all right now."
Kasumi: "I'm sorry I sortied without permission.
But I want to help everyone."
Ymir: "...All right. But don't push yourself too hard."
Steinies: "Tch... Then I've got no choice.
While I hold them off here, go to the village
and burn it down. Make sure you kill his woman and daughter."
Ai: "Touya. I'm doing things my way."
Arthur: "I'm sorry, but this time I'll be acting
Clovis: "I'm acting alone. I'll leave that side to you."
Aurelie: "Sorry, but I'm not ready to put my life in your hands yet.
Xiujian: "...I have no intention of following your orders.
I'll act as I see fit."
Celica: "Sorry, but I can't follow your orders this time."
has yet to dwell within you! I cannot follow such a person's orders!
Therefore, I shall uphold my own justice! That is all!"
Ymir: "Everyone, one of those mechs is moving strangely.
It's definitely heading for the village!
Find some way to stop it!"
Yamato: "We've got to do something, meow!"
Touya: "All right, let's stop that mech first!"
Oh well. I'll save the fun for later.
Steinies: "Tch... This is as far as I go...
Hey, I'm pulling back, but don't screw up.
If you fail... You know what'll happen, don't you?"
Yamato: "Touya! You've got to stop that Armored Mech, quick!"
Zigrim Soldier: "...This is wrong, after all.
Whatever the reason, killing civilians is...
Zigrim Soldier: "You have won this battle."
Zigrim Soldier: "Yes. Be careful of the captain.
He'll do anything to achieve his goals."
If you're going to withdraw, we won't pursue you.
Go on. You have nothing to worry about."
Touya: "But the next time we meet, we might be enemies again."
Steinies: "What are you doing?! Get going already!!"
Zigrim Soldier: "!! Don't tell me you deliberately made me..."
But listen... There isn't a single sane person
Touya: "No way... He killed his own man...
What a bastard... I'll never forgive him!!"
Yamato: "W-We won't make it in time..."
Grad: "I'm settling this with you, here and now..."
I'll defeat you... and kill that woman too..."
To think you can still move this well..."
This scar is throbbing too... Hehehehe.
I'll pay you back for what happened then...
For that day eleven years ago!
What you tried to do was the lowest thing a man could do."
Steinies: "What's wrong with taking a woman by force?
It's that woman's fault in the first place.
She should've just shut up and become mine..."
Grad: "Are you sane?! Thora is my wife!"
Steinies: "I don't give a damn whose woman she is.
You take women and subdue them by force.
But you got in my way. I was so close..."
Steinies: "Whenever I remember what happened then,
Steinies: "I'll make sure Thora receives your head...
Grad: "...I will... not lose to you!"
Grad: "Grr... Have I pushed myself too far...?"
Steinies: "...I-I'll let you off for today!
But next time won't be like this!"
